# config: research other dotfiles

Study other people's dotfiles for ideas:

- [jasonwc/dotfiles](https://github.com/jasonwc/dotfiles) — good examples of config files
- [gerhard/setup](https://github.com/gerhard/setup) — the `go/packages` idea ([[DOT-395]])
- [mokevnin/dotfiles](https://github.com/mokevnin/dotfiles) — Ansible-driven setup

None of the boxes is ticked. The earlier round of the same research was [[DOT-86]] (mathiasbynens).
